validatedPricing.scopeRule: Apply published network/station tariffs only when the PAN row is positively tied to that exact e-Totem-operated network and the applicable offer. Do not infer the 0.59 EUR/kWh SEMOB standard rate across FR*ETI or third-party roaming networks.

failClosedRule: Any station/EVSE without an exact published network/station tariff or exact app/portal tariff remains unpriced. No national fallback and no transfer between e-Totem-managed networks.
